matter_background.original: By a Final Decree dated 2nd December 1999 entered in DC Colombo Partition case No. 523/P, premises bearing Assessment No. 35, Sarasavi Lane Colombo 3 depicted as Lot 3 in Plan No. 2131 dated 12th June 1998 made by Lal Peiris Licensed Surveyor in extent of 30 perches was allotted to Kanthi Perera. She purchased Lot 2 in extent of 30 perches of the said Plan from her brother Wimal Perera by Deed of Transfer 456 dated 6th February 2000 attested Sarath Wickremasinghe Notary Public Colombo. Kanthi Perera amalgamated the said 2 lots and caused to be subdivided into 3 lots depicted as Lot 1,2 and 3 (bearing Assessment Nos. 35/1, 35/2 and 35/3 respectively) in Plan No.567 dated 10th June 2001 made by the same surveyor each containing in extent 20 perches. Mrs Kanthi Perera gifted Lot 1 thereof to Amali Perera a minor who was 16 years old, her daughter from a previous marriage by Deed of Gift No. 1054 dated 6th February 2005 attested by Jagath Perera Notary Public subject to her life interest. In 2013 she sold this property. Mrs Kanthi Perera died intestate on 1st September 2014. Her estate was administered in DC Colombo case No. 567/T and her husband Kamal De Silva was appointed as Administrator. Proceedings of this case was terminated on 6th November 2015. Kanthi had two children out of her marriage to Kamal De Silva namely Anusha and Anuk. Kamal De silva wrote an Administrators Conveyance on 3rd December 2015 and passed the title of Kanthi Perera's intestate Estate to her heirs. Thereafter he gifted his share of the Estate to his two children. Amali Perea was living with his father and after her marriage to Anura Fernando he passed away. Amali met with an accident after one month of her mothers death and died intestate and issueless.
